description: Verify an on-chain payment without trusting any RPC: did this tx transfer at least this amount of a token (default USDC) to this payee, optionally from this payer? Proven by Plumb (Base via proof-backed L1 checkpoints, Ethereum via a light client, XRP Ledger via a quorum of Ripple's validator list: RLUSD, XRP or any issued currency). Bound to the exact transfer (log index); returns the proof level, how long a Base checkpoint can still be challenged, the evidence to re-check, and an Ed25519-signed receipt. Never answers not_paid while a payment is still pending; abstains (unverifiable) whenever the proof is incomplete. Costs $0.02 USDC (x402) ($0.002 for an XRP Ledger payment); asking again about the same claim costs nothing. Optional requiredLevel (releasable or not) and callbackUrl (signed events when the level is reached, the answer changes, or checking gives up).

callbackUrl.description: https URL to notify (signed, retried) when requiredLevel is reached, when the answer changes, or when checking gives up

invoiceId.description: XRPL only: the InvoiceID (64 hex) the payment must carry; binds the answer and its signed receipt to your invoice

logIndex.description: Bind to one transfer: its position within the tx's logs

minAmountRaw.description: Minimum amount in base units, e.g. "50000" = 0.05 USDC (default: any). XRPL: XRP drops, or millionths of an issued currency

payee.description: Address that should have received the money (XRPL: an r... account)

payer.description: Only count transfers from this address (the token holder who paid)

requiredLevel.description: Proof level you need before releasing money (Base: tee_attested < zk_proven < resolved; Ethereum: finalized; XRPL: unl_quorum). The answer then says whether it is releasable.

token.description: ERC-20 contract (default: USDC on the chain). XRPL: RLUSD (default), XRP, or CURRENCY.rIssuer

name: verify_payment
